an10.102:1.1: bhikkhave bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā tisso vijjā paripūrenti.
an10.102:1.3: Satisambojjhaṅgo, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo, viriyasambojjhaṅgo, pītisambojjhaṅgo, passaddhisambojjhaṅgo, samādhisambojjhaṅgo, upekhāsambojjhaṅgo.
an10.102:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā tisso vijjā paripūrenti.
an10.102:1.6: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati,
an10.102:1.7: seyyathīdaṃ ekam pi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo . . . pe . . . iti sākāraṃ sa-uddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
an10.102:1.8: Dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena . . . pe . . . yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
an10.102:1.9: Āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an10.102:1.10: Ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā imā tisso vijjā paripūrentī
